correctness.rationale: For upper-triangular invertible matrices over F_{2^s}, rescaling each coordinate transforms idempotence into Artin-Schreier equations y_j^2+y_j=sum_{i<j}b_ij y_i^2. Frobenius linearity and the nondegenerate absolute trace pairing show each new uniform coefficient row induces a uniform binary linear functional on the existing F_2 solution space of dimension d. It is zero with probability 2^{-d}, so the solution dimension increases to d+1, otherwise stays d. Thus K_n=2^{D_n}-1 and transition probabilities are independent of field extension degree. Conditional moments produce E K_n=n and Var K_n=n(n-1)/2; all-increase and never-increase paths give the two exact extreme atoms. Independent rational Markov calculations verified distributions and moments through n=9; these corroborate rather than prove all n and all s.
